project_type: Two repos: Laravel 12 REST API backend + Vue 3 (Options API) SPA frontend. Backend serves JSON under /api; frontend consumes via axios with Bearer token.
build_system: Backend: Composer + Laravel artisan (no custom build step). Frontend: Vite 7 + @vitejs/plugin-vue + Tailwind v4 (@tailwindcss/vite). ESLint flat config.
test_framework: Backend: PHPUnit 11 (tests/Unit + tests/Feature), SQLite :memory: via phpunit.xml, feature tests use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase and Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum::actingAs($user). Frontend: NO test framework configured (do not add one in this phase).
build_command: Backend: no compile step; Frontend: `npm run build` (from /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind).
test_command: Backend (from /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_laravel12_hostinger): `php artisan test` (optionally `php artisan test --filter Court`). Frontend gate: `npm run build` (and optionally `npm run lint`).
verification_instructions: BACKEND: run `php artisan test` after each backend FEAT; it migrates fresh sqlite :memory: automatically. For routes use `php artisan route:list --path=court` and `--path=admin/courts`. FRONTEND: run `npm run build` after each frontend FEAT (it type/compiles all SFCs and fails on import/template errors); optionally `npm run lint`. There is NO configured pint/phpstan gate — `php artisan test` is the backend gate.
environment_constraints: Backend tests run on sqlite :memory:; migrations must be sqlite-compatible (string-enum columns, explicit indexes, standard foreign keys are fine). Do not depend on MySQL-only features. Frontend baseURL comes from VITE_API_BASE_URL env; do not hardcode URLs. Do not run the dev servers as part of verification; use the build/test gates.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/.kiro steering files exist in either repo. Follow existing conventions strictly (see key_patterns). i18n keys MUST be added to BOTH pt_BR and en lang files (lang/<locale>/error.php and messages.php) — the repo is bilingual by policy stated in those files' headers.
key_patterns: BACKEND: (1) Migrations live in per-domain subfolders under database/migrations/*; AppServiceProvider::boot() globs every subdir and loadMigrationsFrom()s them, so a NEW database/migrations/Courts/ folder auto-loads with no config change. (2) Authenticated routes sit inside Route::middleware('auth:api')->group(...); config/auth.php maps the api guard to the SANCTUM driver. Tests authenticate with Sanctum::actingAs($user) — NEVER Passport::actingAs. (3) Controller injects Service(extends BaseService)+Repository(extends BaseRepository); one save() handles create+update. (4) BaseRepository::updateById($data,$id) is updateOrCreate(['id'=>$id],$data) — an UPSERT; owner-scope fetch-and-guard MUST run before any update, never pass an unverified id in. (5) BaseRepository exposes only create/updateById/createOrUpdateByParameters/firstById/getOrderedBy* — NO bulk-child helper; write children via the Court hasMany relations' createMany(). (6) UploadService::uploadFileToFolder($disk,$folder,$file) returns a folder-prefixed path (e.g. 'courts/ab12.jpg') — store verbatim in photo_path; delete with deleteFileOnFolder('public','courts', basename($path)) (Team passes the full path = double-prefix bug 'logos/logos/..'; do NOT copy it). (7) New enums go in app/Enums as PHP backed enums with a label() method (model: app/Enums/MatchType.php); do NOT use legacy app/Enum. (8) Model relations are camelCase (cityInfo, modalityInfo) but Eloquent default $snakeAttributes=true serializes them snake_cased (city_info, pricing_rules); keep methods camelCase. (9) Team::modalityInfo has REVERSED belongsTo args — do NOT copy; Court::modalityInfo must be belongsTo(Modality::class,'modality_id','id'). (10) Admin features are methods on the single AdminController guarded by one admin+isAdmin route group; AdminController::teams delegates to AdminRepository::getPaginatedTeams — add getPaginatedCourts the same way. (11) isAdmin middleware = is_admin column OR spatie 'admin' role. spatie role grant pattern (app/Console/Commands/AssignRoleOrPermission.php): Role::firstOrCreate(['name'=>...,'guard_name'=>'web']) then $user->assignRole($role). (12) No service currently uses DB::transaction — court create/update intentionally introduces one. (13) Controllers return response()->json(__('messages...'), 201) etc.; validation failures return default 422 with 'errors' map. FRONTEND: (A) axios singleton src/services/api.js, Bearer token from localStorage, uploads use multipart/form-data; error shape err.response.data.errors rendered via Swal (src/services/swal.js). (B) Per-domain route arrays in src/router/*.js spread into src/router/index.js; meta.requiresAuth / meta.requiresAdmin; admin routes ALL live in src/router/admin.js. (C) systemLayout.vue holds navigation[] (groups with children) and adminChildren[] (gated by user.is_admin); heroicons imported from @heroicons/vue/20/solid and registered in components. (D) Reusable selects: ModalitiesSelect.vue (emits an ARRAY even in single mode via its watcher; label hardcoded — add a labelName prop), StateSelectComponent.vue (has labelName prop default 'Estado'), CitySelectComponent.vue (has labelName prop default 'Cidade', loads cities from :state-id). (E) Tailwind v4, dark mode, orange-500 accent; SFCs wrapped in <system-layout>.
